en.headline: World Triathlon Cup returns to Central waterfront this weekend
en.dek: Elite women race at 8:45am and men at 10:30am on Saturday over a sprint course along Lung Wo Road, with a mixed relay on Sunday.
body: The World Triathlon Cup Hong Kong opens on Saturday at the Central and Wan Chai harbourfront, with elite athletes competing over a 750-metre swim, 20-kilometre bike and 5-kilometre run.

Organisers said the women’s race starts at 8:45am and the men’s at 10:30am on Saturday, followed by a mixed team relay on Sunday afternoon. Hong Kong athletes including Oscar Coggins are among the start lists.

The Marine Department has issued a notice closing waters off the Convention and Exhibition Centre during the racing windows and temporarily shutting nearby landing steps. Spectators can watch from the promenade without charge.

zh.headline: 世界三項鐵人盃本周末重返中環海濱
zh.dek: 周六精英女子賽上午8時日分、男子賽上午10時30分於龍和道短程賽道展開，周日有混合接力。
body: 世界三項鐵人盃香港站周六於中環及灣仔海濱開賽，精英選手需完成750米游泳、20公里單車及5公里跑步。
主辦方表示，女子賽周六上午8時日分起步，男子賽上午10時30分起步，周日下午舉行混合接力。香港選手包括Oscar Coggins在內亦有參賽。
海事處已發出通告，賽事期間封閉會展中心以西水域，附近登岸階梯亦暫時關閉。觀眾可免費在海濱長廊觀看。
